label.purpose: Mono data annotations only: units, axis numbers, mineral symbols.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The waitlist action. Ink fill, paper text, crisp 2px edge, electric focus ring, press-scale feedback.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 22px; background: #0b0d12; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #0b0d12; border-radius: 2px; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity .13s cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), transform .13s cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: .86; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,71,255,.4); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Waitlist field. Paper fill, hairline stroke, label above, electric focus ring.
components.css: .ds-label { display:block; margin-bottom:8px; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.08em; color:#626b7a; } .ds-input { width:100%; height:44px; padding:0 14px; background:#fff; color:#0b0d12; border:1px solid #cfd6e0; border-radius:2px; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; font-size:16px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#9aa3b2; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:none; border-color:#0047ff; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(0,71,255,.28); }

components.name: Dose Readout
components.description: The signature instrument readout: a mono, tabular numeral with an electric register tick and unit.
components.css: .ds-readout { position:relative; display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:6px; padding-top:10px; } .ds-readout-tick { position:absolute; top:0; left:0; width:40px; height:1px; background:#0047ff; } .ds-readout-sym { font-family: var(--font-geist-mono), monospace; font-size:12px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.14em; color:#0047ff; } .ds-readout-num { font-family: var(--font-geist-mono), monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight:600; font-size:64px; line-height:.9; letter-spacing:-.03em; color:#0b0d12; } .ds-readout-unit { font-family: var(--font-geist-mono), monospace; font-size:16px; color:#626b7a; }

narrative.overview: WITHIN reads like a bench instrument, not a sports-drink billboard. Its one honest claim is its dosing, so the page is built to let a visitor measure it: a paper-white clinical field ruled with a faint measurement grid, the sachet framed as a specimen, and every number set in a mono readout that ticks up like a meter settling. Persuasion is proof, not volume. The system is quiet in hue and loud in precision: one electric-blue voice spent only on live data or an active choice, everything else ink on paper separated by hairlines. It rejects the sugary sports-drink hero and the generic three-up supplement card grid.
keyCharacteristics: Clinical paper-white canvas over a hairline measurement grid
One electric-blue signal, reserved for actives, live data, and focus
Geist Sans display over Geist Mono numerals (every number is a readout)
Crisp ~2px edges; register marks and crosshairs frame the product as a specimen
Exactly one dark instrument section (the dose); the rest stays light
Motion is instrumentation: hairlines draw, numbers count up, the specimen dissects on scroll

rules.name: The Single Signal Rule
rules.body: Electric appears only where there is live data or an active choice. If it is decorating a surface, remove it.

rules.name: The Flag Red Rule
rules.body: Red is national provenance, not brand color. The only red on the page is the Indonesian flag itself.

rules.name: The One Dark Room Rule
rules.body: Exactly one section inverts to the dark instrument panel (the dose). No other section flips theme; the footer stays light.

rules.name: The Measurement Voice Rule
rules.body: Every number is Geist Mono and tabular. Prose is never mono. Mono is for data, units, and measurement, never as a costume.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Headings carry their own weight. No small uppercase kicker above any heading, anywhere.

rules.name: The Tone-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Layering is tonal surface plus hairline, never an ambient shadow. Shadows only under floating elements and focus.

dos: Do keep electric to actives, live data, and focus.
Do set every numeral in Geist Mono, tabular, counting up on first view.
Do build depth from tonal surfaces and hairlines, framing the product with register marks.
Do let each headline stand alone in sentence case, tight tracking, medium weight.
Do hold exactly one dark instrument section and keep the rest on the clinical light field.
donts: Don't put a kicker or eyebrow above any heading.
Don't use mono for prose or as decoration; mono is data only.
Don't use red for anything but the literal Indonesian flag.
Don't ship the sugary sports-drink hero or the three-up icon-heading-text card grid.
Don't add ambient drop shadows or glass for depth; only floating elements and focus earn a shadow.
Don't claim any certification (BPOM and Halal are pending, not certified).
